issue.title: Regenerate memory README token counts after sase-1id macros.md rewrite
issue.description:
## Memory update

- **Path:** `README.md`

Regenerate with `sase init memory` (memory-write path): the macros.md Approx. tokens count must go 3033->3694 and the total 21237->21898 (ceil of current macros.md chars/4). Do not hand-edit the counts.

Reproduction on this tree (HEAD 3b3d876911 + sase-1id land diff; also fails on clean master per sase-1id note #4):

```
$ just validate
SASE initialization check

Needs attention:
  run  init memory  update memory README
       ~ update  sase/memory/README.md  +2 −2  memory README
```

Root cause: sase-1id phase 6 commit c58ae7491a edited sase/memory/macros.md (truthful-%auto row) and hand-set the README counts to 3033/21237, which do not match the committed note. The generator is the source of truth; the README is derived.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Regenerate with sase init memory so macros.md Approx. tokens reads 3694 and the total reads 21898.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1id phase 6 (c58ae7491a) rewrote sase/memory/macros.md without regenerating sase/memory/README.md, so just validate (SASE validation stage of just check) fails; the land turn cannot fix it because memory writes are out of scope there.
